target_customer: Warehouse and logistics operators that count and check inventory by hand
problem: Manual counting and checking in warehouses is slow and error prone. Powerhouse AI uses phone cameras to count items, read labels and process documents.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (starts at $99 per month per an aggregator, unverified)

founders.name: Ivo Verhaegh
founders.background_notes: Met co-founder at Entrepreneur First Singapore.

founders.name: Kushal Pillay
founders.background_notes: Robotics and computer vision; built models that help robots predict human movement.

technical_complexity.rationale: Phone based counting and label reading is standard computer vision engineering with hard edge cases in messy warehouses.

defensibility.rationale: Data from customer scans helps, but vision vendors and open models are close substitutes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copying found. Drone and robot based rivals raised larger rounds.

market_need_then: Warehouse labor and accuracy pressure in 2021 and 2022; the company claims 20 to 40 percent efficiency gains (claim).

rebrands.why: Domain redirect only; not a name change

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name that collides with PowerHouse Data Centers in search; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Powerhouse AI came from Entrepreneur First Singapore and joined YC in Winter 2022. It sells phone camera based warehouse counting and remains listed as active with six people. Funding is only aggregator sourced and no outcome events were found, so no judgment on success or failure is made.
notes: Funding: aggregators (CB Insights, Prospeo, VCBacked) show a ~$500K convertible note dated 2022-01 or 2022-02 from YC, Entrepreneurs First, DVC and Flood Ventures; not recorded as a round. Location Singapore vs New York conflicts. The website pwh.ai was not fetched. Outcome search returned only an unrelated data center company. Competitor sources were undated or later, so list empty.
